name: shipfast-apple-connect
description: Claude Code plugin that takes any iOS app from a working build to a submission in App Review through the App Store Connect API. Community project, not affiliated with Apple.

plugins.name: shipfast-apple-connect
plugins.description: Release pipeline for iOS apps through the App Store Connect API: signing, availability, listing, products and prices (only with the owner's approval), RevenueCat, screenshots for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, upload and submit. Adds /shipfast.
